items.exampleEn: Many people live in this city.
The woman at the desk is very nice.
I love my life in Taipei.
items.exampleZh: 我很喜歡我在台北的生活。

items.exampleEn: There are many languages in the world.
I live in Taipei with my family.

items.sentenceEn: Bye! See you at the party.

items.audioEn: I live in Taipei, but my parents live in Tainan.
items.audioZh: 我住在台北，但我爸媽住在台南。
items.questionZh: 說話者的爸媽住在哪裡？

items.sentenceEn: People all over the world love music.
items.sentenceZh: 全世界的人都喜歡音樂。

items.sentenceEn: Life in a big city is very busy.

items.stemEn: Many ____ in my town ride bikes.
items.stemZh: 我們鎮上很多人騎腳踏車。

items.passageEn: Tom is a man from Canada. He lives in Taipei now. He works at a school, and he teaches English. He likes his life here, and the people are very nice. Today is his birthday, and his students give him a cake.
items.passageZh: Tom 是來自加拿大的男士，他現在住在台北。他在一所學校工作，教英文。他喜歡在這裡的生活，這裡的人都很好。今天是他的生日，他的學生送他一個蛋糕。

questions.questionZh: 學生今天送 Tom 什麼？

rubricZh: 「那位女士」可寫 that woman、the woman 等（例如 that lady 也正確）
動詞配合主詞（例如 That woman lives）
「住在台北」用 live in（例如 lives in Taipei）
live 配合主詞（例如 They live）
「海邊」可寫，例如 near the sea、by the sea 等
